description: Verify an ed25519-signed receipt: the signature, and — unless you pass onChain:false — both txids against an Algorand indexer. Give it an orderId to check one of this service's own orders, or a receipt object to check ANY receipt in this format, including one issued by another server.

onChain.description: confirm the txids on chain; default true

receipt.description: a receipt {payload, signature}, or an order response containing one

name: verify_receipt
